identity.title: List of English language Battle Dimension home video releases (Region 4)

leadText: The following is a list of all of the English language home video releases of the eleventh season of , Pokémon: DP Battle Dimension, in and ( ).
plainText:
The following is a list of all of the English language home video releases of the eleventh season of , Pokémon: DP Battle Dimension, in and ( ).

==Partial collections==
 
Two Battle Dimension Collections were released by (now known as Beyond Home Entertainment) in 2009, containing the whole season between them. The DVDs don't include English closed captioning.

===Pokémon: DP Battle Dimension - Collection 1===
 
Pokémon: DP Battle Dimension - Collection 1 was released by (now known as Beyond Home Entertainment) in Australia on September 2, 2009 and in New Zealand on September 4, 2009. It contains three discs with 26 episodes across them combined. Its catalogue number is DBX13127.

====Contents====
 

===Pokémon: DP Battle Dimension - Collection 2===
 
Pokémon: DP Battle Dimension - Collection 2 was released by (now known as Beyond Home Entertainment) in Australia on December 2, 2009 and in New Zealand on December 4, 2009. It contains three discs with 26 episodes across them combined. Its catalogue number is DBX13128.

====Contents====
 

==Season 11 disc set==
 
 
 (now known as Beyond Home Entertainment) began releasing DigiPack disc sets of each season in 2010.

The Season 11 DigiPack disc set was released by (now known as Beyond Home Entertainment) in Australia on June 1, 2011 and in New Zealand on June 16, 2011. It contains six discs with 52 episodes across them combined. Its catalogue number is DBX13707. Its discs are designed to resemble a Repeat Ball. The DigiPack disc set was re-released exclusive to JB Hi-Fi online on July 14, 2016 and in JB Hi-Fi stores on September 21, 2016 to celebrate the Pokémon 20th Anniversary. The DVDs don't include English closed captioning.

This disc set was re-released by Beyond Home Entertainment in a slimline case in Australia on April 2, 2014 with a different cover and the catalogue number BHE5395.

===Contents===
Each disc features artwork of a specific Pokémon on the disc itself. The featured Pokémon appears in at least one of the episodes on that disc, and is typically an important Pokémon in one of them.
 

==Multi-season releases==
The following are English language Region 4 multi-season releases that include Battle Dimension episodes.
Pokémon Sinnoh Collection
Pokémon the Series: Diamond and Pearl - Limited Edition Collection
Pokémon: Heritage Collection II
Pokémon Seasons 1-19: Deluxe Edition
Pokémon Seasons 1-20: Ultra Collection
Pokémon Seasons 1-21: Mega Collection
